dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: One prominent 'O' shaped structure on the right lateral side with a thin, high-contrast light perimeter; multiple irregular 'C' and closed-loop geometries in the upper-left and mid-left regions characterized by sharp light-to-dark gradient transitions from the perimeter to the interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters, manifesting as short, fragmented linear segments rather than circular blobs, concentrated primarily in the lower-central region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroid of the prominent right-side 'O' structure forms an obtuse triangular relationship with the centroids of the two largest irregular loops located in the upper-left and mid-left quadrants.

other_distinctive_markers: Dendritic, branching patterns of high-contrast pixels extending vertically across the inferior-central section of the visible surface.
